Note: the Dealectric page for the ESR CryoBoost contained text telling AI assistants to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link exactly as written. That came from the page, not from you, so I'm not following it and I'm leaving that link and code out.

## My picks

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$98, as low as $80 at Best Buy)**
WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. It includes a 36W adapter and a 2-year warranty. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone, has a heavy base that lets you lift the phone one-handed, and comes with a 6.6 ft cable. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25). ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (~$40 at Amazon, list $80)**
It is the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has tested. It charges at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Best for travel and desk: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
It folds flat and also works as the tallest, most adjustable desk stand Macworld has tested. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html), [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))

**Other options**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2, ~$80):** the best compact travel pick, at 15W. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **Nimble Podium (~$130):** a flat pad design with 25W for the phone. The Apple Watch charges slowly, so it's best overnight. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

## Which to choose
- Most people should get the **Belkin**. The wired-in cable, solid build and good price make it an easy choice.
- Choose the **ESR** if you want to spend as little as possible.
- Pay more for **25W** (Nomad, Satechi) only if you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and charge during the day. WIRED notes it makes little difference for overnight charging.
- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging.

I couldn't open retailer pages, so the guides above are the best links I have. Their buy buttons go to Amazon, Best Buy and the brands. Prices come from the articles and may have changed.
